The '''Crimson Prowler Lightsaber''' was a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] lightsaber sold by [[6U-N5]] in the [[Republic outpost (Felucia)|Republic outpost]] for thirty-two [[Felucia Mission Token]]s. It was often used with the [[Crimson Prowler Lightsaber Crystal]].
